# Canadian Stick Curling

> > A comprehensive resource for stick curling in Canada, covering rules, equipment, leagues, and accessibility information for curlers using delivery sticks.

This site serves the Canadian stick curling community with guides for players who use delivery sticks instead of traditional sliding delivery. It includes tournament information, technique resources, and connections to regional curling associations across Canada.

## Key Topics

- stick curling
- delivery stick
- curling rules
- accessibility curling
- senior curling
- Curling Canada
- stick curling leagues
- curling equipment
- modified curling rules
- wheelchair curling
- curling tournaments
- provincial curling associations
- stick delivery technique
- adaptive sports

## Getting Started

- [Canadian Stick Curling Homepage](https://canadianstickcurling.ca): Main landing page with overview of stick curling in Canada
- [What is Stick Curling?](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/about): Introduction to stick curling rules, equipment and accessibility benefits
- [Equipment Guide](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/equipment): Approved delivery sticks, specifications and where to purchase
- [Rules & Regulations](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/rules): Official stick curling rules and modifications from traditional curling

## Playing & Competitions

- [Tournaments & Events](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/tournaments): Calendar of stick curling competitions and championships across Canada
- [Find a League](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/leagues): Directory of stick curling leagues organized by province and region
- [Technique & Strategy](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/technique): Tips for stick delivery, shot-making and game strategy
- [Club Directory](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/clubs): Curling clubs offering stick curling programs nationwide

## Resources & Community

- [Provincial Associations](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/associations): Links to provincial and territorial curling association stick programs
- [News & Updates](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/news): Latest announcements, results and developments in stick curling
- [Coaching Resources](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/coaching): Training materials and certification for stick curling instructors
- [FAQ](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/faq): Frequently asked questions about stick curling eligibility and gameplay

## Optional

- [Contact Us](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/contact): Get in touch with site administrators and submit feedback
- [Privacy Policy](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/privacy): Data collection and privacy practices
- [Sponsors](https://canadianstickcurling.ca/sponsors): Organizations supporting Canadian stick curling
